math-rates-per-person.alt: Two bar charts from invented data. Total use: Town A uses 4.5 million liters a day and Town B 2 million liters a day, so Town A uses more in total. Use per person: Town A has 30,000 people, so 4,500,000 divided by 30,000 is 150 liters per person per day; Town B has 8,000 people, so 2,000,000 divided by 8,000 is 250 liters per person per day. Town B uses more per person.
